name: 1126-mod-function-signature
about: An export with another signature refuses the mod (L505 Name.FunctionSig); the start's check refuses it first (the kept report has the library's exports), so the loader's own bind line is not reached

expect.log: mods: lt-uses-sig: THIS MOD HAS ERRORS

has.text: lt-uses-sig: code/windows-x64/mod.dll: the game has no function "lt-lib/lt.add" with the signature "lumi1:00000000000000ff".
lt-uses-sig: code/linux-x64/mod.so: the game has no function "lt-lib/lt.add" with the signature "lumi1:00000000000000ff".
lt-uses-sig: code/macos-arm64/mod.dylib: the game has no function "lt-lib/lt.add" with the signature "lumi1:00000000000000ff".
